items.name: syncrobotic-theme
items.title: SYNCROBOTIC theme
items.description: Colour, radius, type, height and motion tokens. Replaces the :root, .dark and @theme blocks from shadcn init.

changelog.note: Touch is detected with `any-pointer: coarse`, so a touch laptop with a trackpad keeps 44 px controls, and compact density applies only where nothing is a touch screen.
`--h-thumb` (the slide-to-release thumb: the stop less its inset), so the thumb fills the track in glove and compact density.

Density: `data-density="glove"` (48 px controls, 64 px rows and stop) and `data-density="compact"` (36 px controls, 40 px rows, mouse only; touch keeps 44) on `<html>` or any container. The stop never shrinks.

Focus ring is the foreground colour, no longer the in-progress blue. Chart palette moves off the status hues (violet, teal, olive, magenta, grey for Other), CVD-validated. Type scale gains 2xl (24, figures) and 4xl (36, hero on phones) and is locked: sizes off the scale produce nothing. Adds radius-2xs (4) for controls 24 px and smaller. Warning and danger are told apart by hue and lightness (deutan ΔE 10.8 light / 21.6 dark, was 1.5; 4.8:1 or more as text on every surface). Adds --ease-exit for exits. Blue is defined: a process someone is waiting on, never a state. Adds animate-route-progress (off under reduced motion).
caret-blink animation for one-time-code boxes; stops under reduced motion.
The focus ring appears in the ring colour at once (outline colour set before focus; transition-colors used to fade it from the text colour).
Compact density is for a mouse only: on touch (pointer: coarse) --h-sm is 44 px. The spinner stops under reduced motion. Selected-state rule written down.

Calmer status hues in both modes (all still ≥ 4.5:1 on every surface); colour rule: colour is for what is abnormal. Motion tokens as CSS: appear/disappear, fade-in, sheet-in/out per side, expand/collapse, and the press utility. Chart series tokens --chart-1…5 for light and dark, validated for colour-vision deficiency.
First versioned release. Earlier history is in CHANGELOG.md.

items.name: alarm
items.title: Alarm
items.description: ISA-18.2 alarms: three priorities with their own shape, colour and words, acknowledge and clear states, and a sorted list that announces new alarms to screen readers.

changelog.note: Signals follow the live list: shelved, suppressed and out-of-service alarms stay silent, an alarm back from shelving sounds again, and an unacknowledged critical alarm sounds every 10 s until acknowledged (as the Alarms foundation promised). Critical alarms are never shelved, whatever the data says. The flood clock moves on, so a flood ends when its alarms age out, and only live alarms count. In a flood screen readers hear one count. New `useAlarmSignals` and `AlarmAnnouncer` share all this with the island.

AlarmList buzzes and sounds for a new critical or high alarm (`feedback`, on by default; `feedback={false}` for a record view). The ISA-18.2 states beyond acknowledge: shelved (`shelvedUntil`, `onShelve`/`onUnshelve`; never critical), suppressed by design and out of service (counted under the list), and floods (over 10 in 10 minutes from `raisedAt`: a banner, low alarms folded, one announcement).
A cleared alarm fades out (disappear) instead of vanishing. Icon to label 8 px (gap-2), the same in every component.
Buttons are rounded-xs, concentric with the card.
Only critical unacknowledged alarms are tinted; others are a bar and the word. Acknowledge is an outline button. New alarms appear; buttons press.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The frame of an internal tool: collapsible sidebar (a drawer on phones), top bar with title, environment, search and user, and the page.

changelog.note: Uses `status` instead of `tone` for robot states (same look).
The account button's name includes the initials it shows ("Mei Lin, ML, account menu"), so people using speech input can say what they see (WCAG 2.5.3).

breadcrumb slot before the title; nav counts use CountBadge. One gutter and one inset: panels 8 px apart and from the edge, 16 px inside every panel (top bar, content, footer). Icon to label 8 px (gap-2), the same in every component. The environment badge shows from 640 px, so the page title keeps the room on phones.

Sidebar as a rail below 1280 px that shows the logo and opens over the content (hover with a mouse, tap on touch tablets), with a pin button. Inset layout: two floating panels, no lines in the sidebar, the top bar a layer over the content that gains a backing on scroll. Footer slot. User menu at the sidebar's foot. Search: a top-bar field with a scope that opens the ⌘K palette (search prop). Inset is now the default layout; no line above the footer. Panels are 16 px apart and 16 px from the edge, the same gutter as the cards inside them.
First release. Links and buttons press. Brand row matches the top bar's height and hairline; title, content and the user row share the 24 px edge; optional logo.

items.name: top-bar-shell

changelog.note: The account button's name includes the initials it shows ("Mei Lin, ML, account menu"), so people using speech input can say what they see (WCAG 2.5.3).
First release. The floating bar's edges line up with the content below.

items.name: agent-skill

changelog.note: Light is the default theme; dark is for control rooms and night shifts.

Links point to design-system.syncrobotic.me. The design language and checklist catch up with 0.10 and 0.11: blue only for a process being waited on, calm states grey, readable disabled text, the exit easing, the 2xs radius and the type scale, density, touch and sound, the icon set and the alarm states.
First release.
